## Found-weapon rarity

Weapons found on the islands come with a rarity on top, and last until the expedition ends.

| Rarity | Damage | Magazine | Reload time | Fire interval |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Common | x1 | x1 | x1 | x1 |
| Fine | x1.15 | x1.15 | x0.92 | x0.95 |
| Rare | x1.3 | x1.3 | x0.85 | x0.9 |
| Epic | x1.38 | x1.4 | x0.78 | x0.9 |
| Legendary | x1.5 | x1.5 | x0.7 | x0.86 |

## Weapon elements

| Element | On hit |
|---|---|
| Ember | Burns: 5 damage a second for 3s. |
| Frost | Chills: slows for 1s, and every 5th hit freezes them in place. |
| Storm | Every 4th hit arcs to 2 more foes for half damage. |
| Venom | Poisons: 3 damage a second and a light slow. |
| Void | Drains: heals you for 8% of the damage you deal. |

## Named weapons

Always Legendary and elemental, with a perk and 10% more damage. Wardens and vaults drop them, rarely.

| Name | Weapon | Element | Perk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sunsplitter | Greatsword | Ember | Burns twice as hot. |
| Hoarfang | Sniper | Frost | Freezes on every hit, not every 5th. |
| Thunderclap | Minigun | Storm | Arcs on every 2nd hit, not every 4th. |
| Widowsting | SMG | Venom | Poison bites harder and slows more. |
| Hollowsong | Rifle | Void | Drains 20% instead of 8%. |

## Run perks

Offered three at a time during an expedition (pick with 1, 2 or 3). They last the run.

| Perk | Effect | Stacks |
|---|---|---|
| Quick Hands | Reload 30% faster. | 1 |
| Second Wind | One extra dash charge. | 1 |
| Featherfall | Your glider lasts 60% longer. | 1 |
| Scavenger | Gems you pick up are worth 25% more. | 2 |
| Tough Skin | +15 max health, healed right away. | 3 |
| Overcharge | Your bond ultimate charges 30% faster. | 1 |
| Keen Edge | 8% more damage. | 3 |
| Fleet Foot | 6% faster on foot. | 2 |
| Plating | +20 max armor. | 2 |
| Clear Mind | Abilities recharge 12% faster. | 2 |
| Tailwind | Glide 15% faster. | 1 |
| Remedy | Tonics heal 40% more. | 1 |

## Without a class kit

Every player and bot now plays a class, whose kit owns Shift and right click. A hunter without one falls back to these: the weight class's dodge and the weapon's own right-click utility.

| Weight | Dodge | Cooldown | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medium | Combat Roll | 9s | Medium: a quick roll that slips a third of a magazine in on the way. Roll through a hit as it lands for a perfect dodge: your next shots crit. |
| Light | Phase Step | 6.5s | Light: a short, very fast phase. Shots pass straight through you for the whole step. In the air, or on cooldown, Shift does the long dash. |
| Heavy | Shoulder Charge | 12s | Heavy: a short charge nothing can knock back (2 charges). Anyone you run into is bowled aside, and slammed into a wall they're stunned 1.2s. |

| Weapon | Right click | Cooldown | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shotgun | Breach | 8s | A point-blank blast that throws everyone in front of you 6m back (into a wall: stunned) and kicks you backwards out of the fight. |
| Minigun | Bulwark | 12s | Raise a 3m energy shield in front of you for 5s (160 HP). It turns with your aim and stops enemy shots; yours go through. |
| Greatsword | Earthshatter | 10s | Leap up to 7m and smash down: everyone within 3m is thrown into the air; anyone already airborne is spiked (+60% damage, stunned 1s). |
| Burst Rifle | Leash Bolt | 10s | A bolt that leashes whoever it hits to you for 3.5s. If they get 6m away it snaps: 22 damage, stunned 1s, dragged back. |
| Rifle | Rail Charge | 8s | Hold to charge for up to 1s, let go to fire a rail that pierces everyone in its line: 10 to 34 damage, 9 to 17m, full charge stuns. |
| SMG | Razor Disc | 7s | Throw a spinning disc 8m that cuts everything it passes, then flies back to you and cuts them again. |
| Longsword | Riposte | 8s | Raise your blade for 0.7s: shots hitting your front fly back at the shooter (+30%), and a sword or claw that hits it is parried and stunned 1s. |
| Twin Blades | Shadow Step | 8s | Throw a knife 9m. If it hits, you appear behind that foe and your next hits for 1.5s crit. |
| Sniper | Tripwire Mine | 10s | Plant a mine up to 8m away (2 charges). The first rival to step on it is rooted 1.4s, revealed for 3s and takes 14. |
